Essay B flows loosely without clear paragraph development.", "quality": "Organizational structure", "description": "The use of coherent paragraphing and logical progression of ideas to build a developed argument."}, {"evidence": "Essay A develops each point with extended personal anecdotes (the friend's guitar class, the drama class, the art teacher) that support the thesis; Essay B lists examples briefly without elaboration.", "quality": "Idea development", "description": "The capacity to elaborate on supporting points with concrete, extended examples that advance the argument."}, {"evidence": "Essay A uses direct quotes from the friend and teacher to support claims; Essay B has no such rhetorical devices.", "quality": "Rhetorical use of evidence", "description": "The strategic incorporation of quoted voices and illustrative material to strengthen persuasive points."}, {"evidence": "Essay A maintains a consistent argumentative stance throughout (students should be required to take arts classes), while Essay B shifts between personal skills, family roles, and travel advice without a clear thesis.", "quality": "Thesis coherence", "description": "The maintenance of a clear central claim that unifies the essay and guides each paragraph."}, {"evidence": "Essay A uses cohesive transitions and connectors (\"In conclusion\", \"above all\", \"That's why\", \"For that reasons\") to link ideas; Essay B jumps between topics with minimal linking.", "quality": "Cohesive linking", "description": "The use of transitional phrases and connectors to create smooth flow between sentences and paragraphs."}]}
